page.overview:
Who is Robin?

Robin as Dick Grayson was created by Bill Finger and Bob Kane, first appearing in (1940).Jason Todd first appeared as Robin in (1984).Tim Drake became Robin in (1990).Stephanie Brown took on the position in Robin #126 (2004).Damian Wayne has been Robin since (2009).

Also known as: The Boy Wonder.
